previous_statement: By lem-extcb-four-corner-merge applied to the supplied amplified four-corner datum and the preceding smallness bound, there is a bijective map v:B_U oplus B_V->A_R which is an extended delta-isomorphism for delta:=C_merge*(rho+epsilon_{A_R}); it satisfies delta<=M*t. By def-extended-delta-inclusion, increasing a nonnegative defect parameter only relaxes the homomorphism and two-sided norm inequalities, so M<=D_3 makes this same v an extended D_3*t-isomorphism.
new_statement: Under the root antecedent and the choices in 1.1, rho+epsilon_{A_R}<=(C_cross^0+1)*t<=a_merge. Hence lem-extcb-four-corner-merge, applied to the supplied amplified four-corner datum, yields a bijective v:B_U oplus B_V->A_R that is an extended delta-isomorphism for delta:=C_merge*(rho+epsilon_{A_R}). As delta is a nonnegative defect parameter, delta<=abs(C_merge)*(rho+epsilon_{A_R})<=K*t<=D_3*t. By def-extended-delta-inclusion, replacing a nonnegative defect bound by a larger one only relaxes every amplified homomorphism-error and two-sided norm inequality, while bijectivity is unchanged; therefore v is an extended D_3*t-isomorphism.
